questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she _____ to the cinema the following week.
Select the correct reported speech form: He said, 'I have just finished my homework.'
options: He said he had just finished his homework.
He said he has just finished his homework.
He said he was just finishing his homework.
He said he would finish his homework.
questions.answer: He said he had just finished his homework.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly reports the meaning of 'I’m not sure whether I should go or not'?
options: He said he wasn’t sure whether to go or not.
He said he wasn’t sure if he should go or not.
He said he wasn’t sure whether he should go or not.
He said he wasn’t sure whether he should not go or not.
questions.answer: He said he wasn’t sure whether to go or not.

questions.question: Identify the correct passive voice form: The report was written by the committee.
options: The report was written by the committee.
The report has been written by the committee.
The report were written by the committee.
The report is written by the committee.
questions.answer: The report was written by the committee.

Select the correct reported speech form: He suggested, 'We should start early.'
options: He suggested we should start early.
He suggested we had started early.
He suggested we would start early.
questions.answer: He suggested we should start early.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a modal verb for ability in the past? She couldn’t speak English fluently when she first arrived.
options: She couldn’t speak English fluently when she first arrived.
She couldn’t speak English fluently when she first arrived.
She couldn’t speak English fluently when she first arrived.
She couldn’t speak English fluently when she first arrived.
questions.answer: She couldn’t speak English fluently when she first arrived.
